name: atNorth SWE01 Stockholm metro (Kista)
notes: atNorth official page: SWE01 opened March 2022 in Kista, renewable-powered with heat recovery (colocation/high-density compute). Feb 2026: Equinix and CPP Investments agreed a USD 4.2bn deal to acquire atNorth (Partners Group seller) - ownership context; facility status unchanged.

name: atNorth SWE02 Stockholm metro (Akalla)
notes: atNorth official: SWE02 in Akalla, 1.5-hectare metro site near SWE01 campus, 30 MW, heat-reuse enabled, scheduled to go live Q4 2027. Announced 2026-01-29.

name: Conapto Stockholm 4 South
notes: Conapto opened Stockholm 4 South in 2024; Oct 2025 announcement adds 8 MW from Ellevio scaling the site from 20 MW to 28 MW (capacity ready from 2026-01-01). Baxtel lists Conapto STHLM 4 South as the largest Stockholm facility at 28 MW / ~68,889 sq ft.

name: evroc flagship data center, Arlandastad (Stockholm Arlanda)
notes: evroc official: flagship hyperscale cloud/AI data center next to Stockholm Arlanda Airport (Arlandastad land acquired from Arlandastad Group). Sifted: ~3,500 m2 stone-built data centre; evroc planned EUR 600m raise and 16,000 GPUs at full capacity. Status planned - no completion date confirmed in this run.

name: Equinix Stockholm data centers (SK1/SK2/SK3)
notes: Equinix official page states three data centers in Sweden (~160,000 sq ft colocation space); SK2 has an environmental permit (miljotillstand per Chapter 9 miljobalken) granted by the Stockholm County MPD (per methodology Naturvardsverket-hosted decision).

name: Digital Realty / Interxion Stockholm (STO1-STO6, Kista/Akalla)
notes: Digital Realty official Stockholm page lists six Kista/Akalla facilities (STO1-STO6), ~25,000 m2 colocation, 115+ cloud/network providers. Legacy Interxion names normalized to Digital Realty per methodology de-dup rule.

name: Bahnhof Stockholm data centers (Pionen, Thule, S:t Erik, Gullan)
notes: Bahnhof official pages list Swedish colocation facilities incl. Pionen (Cold War-era nuclear bunker, 30 m underground), Thule, S:t Erik (largest, ~85,000 sq ft) and Gullan/Kista; three of five Bahnhof DCs connected to Stockholm district heating (Fortum Varme). Pionen ~400-800 kW cooling load per Open District Heating pilot. Aggregate record for the Stockholm cluster; Sparven (Malmo) recorded under Scania in the other part-batch.

name: GleSYS Stockholm (Vastberga)
notes: GleSYS official location page: Stockholm/Vastberga data center, mission-critical colocation/cloud facility (hosting provider with separate 10 MW Falkenberg site in Halland county - part 2 batch).

name: EdgeConneX Skelleftea campus (former Northvolt/Lyten site, Bergsbyn)
notes: EdgeConneX announced plans to acquire the Skelleftea site from Lyten (former Northvolt battery plant, Torsgatan 122 Bergsbyn); DCD reports the campus could support up to 1 GW, subject to approvals and full development. DatacenterMap lists the entry at 1,000 MW. Status planned/early; capacity is site potential, not committed IT load.

name: NDC Finnfors / Skelleftea Kraft green data center park
notes: NDC official release (2019) announced one of Sweden's largest 100% renewable-powered data center parks at Finnfors outside Skelleftea in JV with Skelleftea Kraft. No current status confirmed in this run - treat as stale/planned lead; Umea searches found no named facility.

name: Meta Lulea Data Centre (Datavagen 15)
notes: Meta official locations: Lulea with 8.7B+ SEK investment; opened 2013 as Meta's first data center outside the US (NCC project page confirms). Meta community grants also cover Boden/Kalix/Pitea/Alvsbyn municipalities, indicating regional footprint.

name: Hydro66 / Northern Data Boden data center
notes: Hydro66 brought a hydro-powered Boden facility online with 3.2 MW initial power (2015); later market listings identify the former Hydro66 site under Northern Data/Ardent. Current operating status should be treated as historical unless refreshed by a newer primary source; no fresh Boden/Hive Digital public source found in this run.

name: KnC Miner Boden data center
notes: Data Center Knowledge reported KnC Miner operating a 30 MW Boden data center on low-cost hydropower (2015). Historical record; current status unverified in this run.

name: RISE Lulea data center testbed (research/edge)
notes: RISE runs a data center testbed in Lulea - research/edge facility per SE methodology; useful context for the Boden/Lulea AI/HPC ecosystem. Not a commercial colocation facility.

name: Vantage ARN1 Tierp / Mehedeby campus
notes: Baxtel listing and Stockholm Business Region post identify Vantage's first Sweden campus at Tierp/Mehedeby, Uppsala County, planned ~2028; capacity not disclosed. Municipal planning files not yet found in this run - C-grade lead per methodology (Tierp/Mehedeby markforvarv watch item).

name: Datacenter Uppsala AB (Uppsala city)
notes: Official site of Datacenter Uppsala AB (Vretgrand 18, 753 22 Uppsala) offering colocation/hosting services; small local facility, no capacity or technical detail verified in this run. C-grade per methodology (no independent verification found).

name: AWS Europe (Stockholm) Region - Eskilstuna and Katrineholm data centers
developer: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Data Services Sweden AB)
notes: Business Sweden: AWS opened data centers in Eskilstuna, Vasteras and Katrineholm in 2018 (Stockholm region eu-north-1). About Amazon (Nov 2024): AWS building new data centres in Eskilstuna, Katrineholm and Vasteras with main buildings due mid-2025. Vasteras part is recorded under Vastmanland (part 2 batch).

name: Brookfield Strangnas AI Data Center
notes: Brookfield official release: SEK 95 billion (~USD 10bn) AI infrastructure investment centered on a new AI data center in Strangnas (about 60 km west of Stockholm); DCD reports 750 MW over 10-15 years. Status planned; listed among top-3 largest DC projects in Europe (construction review).

name: EdgeMode Marviken AI data center (Vikbolandet, Norrkoping)
notes: EdgeMode and Vertical Data announced (Aug 2025) a 20 MW AI-optimized data center at Marviken (Marvikens Kraftverk, Vikbolandet) with 95 MW renewable PPA, immersion cooling and district-heating integration; DC Byte notes Phase 1 ~15 MW IT load at the Marviken Smart Energy Cluster; DatacenterMap lists 95 MW site power and scale beyond 500 MW potential per company material. Status: announced/MoU stage.

name: National Supercomputer Centre (NSC), Linkoping University
notes: University HPC/data services center at Campus Valla, Linkoping; hosts national supercomputing resources (Berzelius, Tetralith upgrades). Official university page - A-grade for existence; not a commercial colocation facility.

name: Junet Datacenter (Birka, Huskvarna)
notes: Junet official datacenter page (verified live) describes a reliable, environmentally friendly server hall with dedicated fiber, redundant power and efficient cooling - colocation service. Aggregators place the facility at Birkagatan 41, Huskvarna (Junet Birka). B-grade: official service page + aggregator location.

name: Invid Jonkoping data center
notes: Datacenterplatform lists Invid Jonkoping at Batterigatan 18, Jonkoping; limited public technical detail found in this run - C-grade aggregator entry.

name: Ansluten Vaxjo data center
notes: Ansluten official Vaxjo datacenter page (hosting/colo); Data Center Map lists the facility at Honnorsgatan 10 with ~150 sqm data-center area within a 250 sqm site. Small local facility; no capacity verified - C-grade (official service page exists, specs unverified).

name: Kalmar NDC Datacenter
notes: Kalmar NDC website describes backup/datacenter services; DataCenterPlatform lists Kalmar NDC Datacenter at Sodra Vagen 58, Kalmar. Small local/backup facility; C-grade aggregator entry with company site corroboration.

name: BRS Networks / DLC NEZ Gotland data center
notes: DCD (2015) reported DLC expanding into a Tier III Gotland facility codenamed NEZ built by BRS Networks, set to open 2016. No current operating evidence found in this run (island grid constraints per methodology); status unknown - historical B-grade lead only.

name: Hostek Karlskrona data center
notes: Hostek lists a Tier 3 data center in Karlskrona, southeast Sweden; Data Center Map places it at Ronnebygatan 36, Karlskrona. Hosting provider with official location page - B-grade for existence.

name: Affarsverken Karlskrona data center (Galgamarken-Trosso)
notes: Inflect lists an Affarsverken-operated carrier-neutral data center at 53 Norra Smedjegatan, Karlskrona with 1.4 MW power capacity. Aggregator-only - C-grade.
